subject: Multinote VAT tagging & billing-contact transfer plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@faberco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multinote VAT tagging & billing-contact transfer plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call this morning. We want to lock down two things before we flip invoicing for Q1: 1) whether FaberCo can accept a single PDF invoice that lists multiple remit-to destinations (we call this a "multinote" invoice), and 2) who should receive the invoices (AP portal enrollment vs. direct email).

Quick summary of our proposal:
- Redwood will send consolidated monthly invoices with invoice lines tagged by entity and VAT rate (we can output UBL or a plain PDF).
- If FaberCo prefers portal ingestion, we will push structured invoices to your portal webhook; otherwise we will send PDFs to a designated billing address.
- For VAT evidence, we can attach a per-entity VAT mapping CSV and include a VAT breakdown section in the PDF.

Can you confirm: 1) whether FaberCo will accept a single PDF with multiple remit lines (multinote) or needs separate invoices per remit, and 2) the canonical billing contact (email) if you want PDF-by-email?

I attached an example PDF with the proposed multinote layout. If you opt for the portal, Connor will coordinate the webhook/field mapping. If you opt for email, Kimberly will confirm the final billing address and PO/PO-number handling.

Next steps: if you confirm one of the two options, we can schedule a 30-min mapping call and draft the AP onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Rishi
Sr. Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: faberco-einvoice-sample.pdf (PDF, 52KB)

From: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@faberco.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: FaberCo AP Team <ap@faberco.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multinote VAT tagging & billing-contact transfer plan

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear summary and the sample. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Multinote PDF: Our finance ops can accept a single PDF with multiple remit lines as long as each remit line clearly shows the remit-to legal entity and VAT number. We’ll want each remit row to have an entity code that maps to our ERP.

2) Portal vs Email: We prefer portal ingestion for structured invoices where possible. That said, there are two legacy entities in our system that still require emailed PDFs for now. So we’re looking at a hybrid approach: portal primary, email fallback for legacy legal entities.

3) VAT evidence: We need the VAT breakdown per line item, and we need a separate CSV with entity-level VAT IDs.

I’ve copied our AP inbox so they can confirm the portal endpoint and share a sample mapping file. 

Can we do the mapping call on Wednesday morning (US EST)?

Best,
Emma
Head of Finance Ops
FaberCo

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@faberco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multinote VAT tagging & billing-contact transfer plan

Emma —

Appreciate the quick reply and the hybrid preference — that works. Confirming our action items: 

- We will treat portal ingestion as the primary path. Connor will reach out to your AP team to get the webhook URL and sample payloads.
- For the legacy entities that need emailed PDFs, Kimberly will confirm the exact billing addresses and any PO-number header requirements.
- We will include per-line VAT tags and attach a VAT-ID mapping CSV (see attached sample).

Connor: can you take point on webhook integration? Please validate required fields: invoice_number, remit_entity_code, line_vat_rate, line_net_amount, line_tax_amount, and total_payable. Also add a field remit_email when the fallback is used.

Kimberly: please draft the email-only billing contact matrix (entity -> address -> PO header) and I’ll share with FaberCo.

Emma: does FaberCo need a formal one-time consent to switch primary ingestion to portal (for our audit trail)? If yes, we can send a short consent form (DocuSign) that lists entities to be moved to portal primary and legacy entities to be email-only.

Thanks —
Rishi

Attachment: faberco-vat-mapping.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multinote VAT tagging & billing-contact transfer plan

Quick internal note after sync with Connor:

- Connor will open a ticket (FIN-321) to track the webhook mapping work and will request the sample URL from FaberCo.
- I started the billing contact matrix draft. Current plan is: portal primary for entities FC-EU and FC-US; email-only for legacy FC-OLD1 and FC-OLD2. I’ll finalize the addresses and PO-header requirements by EOD Thu (tomorrow PST).
- We should include the DocuSign one-time consent only if Emma's team requests it; otherwise an email confirmation from their AP inbox is sufficient for our audit trail.

I attached the preliminary matrix and the sample CSV we plan to send.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing-contact-matrix-draft.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)
